title: Orcaslicer (LinuxServer.io)
description: Is slisneoir foinse oscailte é Orca Slicer do phrintéirí FDM. Is forc de chuid Bambu Studio é OrcaSlicer, ar a dtugtaí BambuStudio-SoftFever roimhe seo, is forc de chuid PrusaSlicer le Prusa Research é Bambu Studio, atá ó Slic3r le Alessandro Ranellucci agus pobal RepRap.
tagline: Sliseoir foinse oscailte do phrintéirí FDM. Is forc de chuid Bambu Studio é OrcaSlicer, ar a dtugtaí BambuStudio-SoftFever roimhe seo, is forc de chuid PrusaSlicer le Prusa Research é Bambu Studio, atá ó Slic3r le Alessandro Ranellucci agus pobal RepRap.
